l13.label: Independent elective
l13.requires: An L01 project and model. This module prepares Search, embeddings, and an index, which also provide the foundation for L12.

l14.label: Prerequisites required
l14.requires: Reuse your L11 Search/index and L01 models/receipt for local invocation and deployment. Needed only for L18's actual Hosted branch.

l15.label: Independent elective
l15.requires: A basic project/model, ownership receipt, and separate .venv-advanced environment. Check the chosen pattern's TPM and request limit in L02 first. Neither L12 Hosted deployment nor an A2A connection is required.

l15-collaboration.label: Choose after environment setup
l15-collaboration.requires: Reuse L13's .venv-advanced environment and model-capacity check. Paid sequential/concurrent runs are not prerequisites; approve group-chat and handoff call limits separately.

l16.label: Independent elective
l16.requires: A basic project, chat and embedding deployments, and access to supported Memory features. No other advanced module is required.

l17.label: Separate feature paths
l17.requires: A routine can run independently with the server-side prompt agent from L05. The long-running Hosted path requires L12.

l21.label: Independent elective
l21.requires: Repair local cache/access checks and write your control design. Actual inspection/changes separately require resource-level permissions and approved scope.

l22.label: Choose deployment/recovery capabilities
l22.requires: Use L01's environment/sources for CI failure/repair and release/recovery design. L12 is needed only for the actual Hosted branch. Publishing requires protocol/server tools/organizational access and separate approval; it is not a core requirement.
